page.overview:
What is Super Mutants?

Super Mutants belongs to Fallout. Super mutant is a general term referring to humanoid mutants created by exposing a regular human to a variety of the Forced Evolutionary Virus (FEV).

The resulting hulking mutants typically possess exceptional strength, endurance, resistance or immunity to disease and radiation, and modified intelligence.

A common trait of all super mutants is that they are sterile and cannot reproduce (one variety is even explicitly asexual in that they are devoid of identifiable sexual characteristics). All are masculine in appearance, with some mutants being larger and more monstrous in size.

Also known as: Super Mutant, Supermutants.
